why: Give an enemy minion -3 Attack lowers one enemy, but "friendly minions gain +3 Attack" is a stat rise.
Boost an enemy unit by 3, then an allied unit by 9 raises stats.
Annoying: the opposing creature "gains 1 Power," a stat rise.
All other Vek receive +1 HP, which raises their health.
Steal 1 Power and self power set to distinct costs; the self gain counts as stat rise.
Give a nearby enemy -2 attack this turn only lowers an enemy stat.
Azarai's own power is set to a product, a rise for itself.
Boost an allied unit by 5 raises that unit's strength.
Stinky: the opposing creature "loses 1 Power," a stat drop.
Afflict the 2 highest-Power enemy cards ... with -2 Power is a stat drop.
The stolen minion is summoned to the owner's side, so new units land on the owner's side.
Spawn a Rowdy Dwarf on this row puts a new unit on the owner's side.
Vek emerge on the marked space; the text does not say which side owns the spawn.
Spawn a 1 strength enemy Raven places an enemy unit on the opposing side.
Dying Wish summons a random minion "on this space," on the owner's side.
Melee half summons to the enemy row (board_clog); Ranged half summons to your own row.
Puts a card from each hand onto both sides; the enemy-side half is board_clog.
Spawn an Operative on each enemy row puts units on the opponent's side.
Add a card from your opponent's deck to their side of this location.
Summon the top bronze unit from your opponent's deck to the opposite row is enemy side.
